description.value:
Few sights unsettle a battlefield like a berserker who has learned to channel the Force through unrestrained rage. Followers of the Marauder Approach tap a wellspring of primal power buried beneath their fury, turning brute strength into something closer to a force of nature — fire, blade, and blood woven together by instinct rather than discipline.

Because this power rises from chaos rather than control, marauders walk a dangerous edge: many are drawn to the dark side's promise of raw strength, and even those who resist still hear its voice whispering beneath their anger.
